hero.title: Capturing Your Forever,
hero.subtitle: Timeless wedding cinematography and breathtaking drone videography for couples who want their story told like cinema.

artist.label: The Artist
artist.title: Every love story
paragraphs: SR Studio began with a single camera and a belief: the quiet glances and unplanned laughter matter as much as the grand moments.

Today our team blends documentary storytelling with cinema-grade cameras, prime lenses and licensed drones, while our approach remains deeply personal. We get to know every couple before the day, so we can capture who you truly are.

services.title: Wedding Photography
services.description: Full-day coverage from getting ready to the final farewell, with meticulous high-resolution editing.

services.title: Cinematic Videography
services.description: Films that feel like cinema: emotional, intimate and beautifully graded.

services.title: Drone & Aerial
services.description: Breathtaking 4K aerial perspectives of your venue, procession and celebrations.

testimonials.name: Ananya & Rohan
testimonials.text: They were everywhere and nowhere at once. Our film made every single guest cry. It's the most precious thing we own.

testimonials.name: Priya & Karan
